component.name: FATE
component.summary: Text and code editor with live Markdown preview

description.p: FATE (Formatted Article & Text Editor) is a free and open source text and code editor, in the spirit of Notepad++. Any text file opens: code, configuration files, logs, scripts and files with no extension at all. The editor is built on CodeMirror, with syntax highlighting for around 150 languages, tabs, find and replace, multiple cursors and column selection, code folding, split view and diffs. Files changed on disk reload in place while your buffer is clean, and never over unsaved edits.

It is also a Markdown editor and viewer. Documents render as a typeset page with KaTeX mathematics (including multi-line matrices and equations inside headings), Mermaid diagrams, syntax-highlighted code fences and a live table of contents, and an edit mode puts the source beside a live preview. A repair layer fixes badly escaped LaTeX from Markdown generators and export tools before it reaches the screen.

Eight themes plus a custom theme builder, a bundled font library with per-file-type overrides, a command palette, rebindable shortcuts, print to PDF with a real preview, and session restore. Fully offline: no telemetry, no network requests.
